title: SFTPClient does not keep a reference to the Client
body:
SFTPClient does not keep (properly) a reference to the parent, so when it falls out of scope and gets closed, the sftp object becomes unusable.

``` python
>>> import paramiko
>>>
>>> username = "xxx"
>>> key_filename = 'xxx'
>>> hostname = 'xxx'
>>> port = 22

>>> def connect():
...     client = paramiko.SSHClient()
...     client.load_system_host_keys()
...     client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
...     client.connect(hostname, port, username, key_filename=key_filename)
...     sftp = client.open_sftp()
...     return sftp
...
>>> sftp = connect()
>>> sftp.listdir()
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<input>", line 1, in <module>
  File "/usr/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/paramiko/sftp_client.py", line 153, in listdir
    return [f.filename for f in self.listdir_attr(path)]
  File "/usr/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/paramiko/sftp_client.py", line 174, in listdir_attr
    t, msg = self._request(CMD_OPENDIR, path)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/paramiko/sftp_client.py", line 646, in _request
    num = self._async_request(type(None), t, *arg)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/paramiko/sftp_client.py", line 668, in _async_request
    self._send_packet(t, msg)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/paramiko/sftp.py", line 170, in _send_packet
    self._write_all(out)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/paramiko/sftp.py", line 135, in _write_all
    raise EOFError()
EOFError
>>>
>>> client = paramiko.SSHClient()
>>> client.load_system_host_keys()
>>> client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
>>> client.connect(hostname, port, username, key_filename=key_filename)
>>> sftp = client.open_sftp()
>>> sftp.listdir()
[u'xxx']
```
